plain: The Marine Sulphur Queen, a ship that left port in Port Arthur, Texas, sank and was lost at sea in 1963. Mario Woods, a former guard at a nuclear site, tells Michels it was the first ship he ever set foot on, as a boy of five, which ties him personally to a well-known sea mystery.
